Электронный мультиметр – цифровой прибор: An electronic multimeter is a digital device for measuring various characteristics of electrical circuits, mainly voltage, current, and resistance. The multimeter contains rather complex electronic circuits that convert input current characteristics. You do not need to know these circuits and their principles of operation in detail. You only need to know the following:
в любом режиме работы реально проводится: in any operating mode, a voltage measurement is actually performed on some internal resistor, and the obtained voltage value is then "converted" into the required measured quantity;
в режиме измерения сопротивлений мультим: in resistance measurement mode, the multimeter has an internal voltage source;
для измерения напряжения внутренний исто: no internal source is needed for voltage measurement;
при протекании тока через растворы элект: various galvanic effects occur when current flows through electrolyte solutions.
